intro: StorageCafe has no industry-statistics page for Missoula. Its listings page puts the non-climate 10x10 average at $106/month (September 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $179. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city, and Storage Stats has no market page for it, so that StorageCafe figure is the advertised rate. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe listings non-climate averages; no industry-statistics page); no StorageUnitCosts city page; no Storage Stats market page

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe listings non-climate average $59 (Sep 2026). Only one published figure for this size. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$68. Non-climate listings from about $44 (Oct 2026).

Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe listings non-climate average $72 (Sep 2026). Only one published figure for this size. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$117. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. Listings-page non-climate average $106 (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). No industry-statistics street-rate page for this city. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Storage Stats does not publish a market page for this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$179. Non-climate listings from about $85 (Oct 2026).
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe listings non-climate average $143 (Sep 2026). Only one published figure for this size. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$206.

Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe listings non-climate average $141 (Sep 2026). Only one published figure for this size. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$338. Non-climate listings from about $115 (Oct 2026).

local_tips: Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
